description: Pixel art portrait of just the floating head of a ship's AI, no neck, no shoulders, no body, a hologram of a woman's face, calm, half-lidded and mildly unimpressed, a dry little almost-smile, short hair, facing the viewer, made of warm amber projector light with soft scanlines, like a heat glow, faint glitch at the edges, projected inside a dark ship console with a few cold indicator lights, deep indigo dark filling every edge, no lettering
